$description: onair.music design tokens — direction A "ON AIR": broadcast red on warm black. Single source of truth; platform theme files (iOS RadioBugTheme.swift, Android Color.kt/colors.xml, web tailwind.config.ts) must mirror these values exactly. Run generate.mjs to print platform snippets.
rules: Accent ONLY on interactive elements and at most one hero element per screen.
Gradient ONLY on the primary CTA and the hero gauge; everything else flat.
No radial glow backgrounds. No glass/blur on list rows — solid surface + 8% white hairline border.
LIVE indicator is pulsing accent red (broadcast convention). Detection marker is amber, distinct from brand red.
error (#FF8A80) sits close to brand red — always pair it with an icon.
textQuaternary only for micro-labels >= 10pt bold uppercase (contrast is borderline).

typography.note: Numbers, ISRC, timestamps in IBM Plex Mono. Android: Sora is a variable font — every Font() needs FontVariation.Settings(weight).
